models.expanded_candidate: after user training; record exact checkpoint and params hash

offline_holdout.purpose: fixed demonstration validation; no claim of unseen layouts

position_variation.setup_guard: Use existing fresh-scene relocation checks; geometry failures reported separately, never omitted silently

types: misaligned placement then lift and replace
recovery.protocol: Create and hash fixed simulator snapshots once, use the same snapshots for each model; no human actions after autonomous evaluation begins; quarantine these from training
recovery.recording: record full physics state, task resource hashes, controller reset policy and intervention history

metrics: full release and retreat success / attempted trials
exceptions and setup failures reported explicitly
selection: Keep this fixed evaluation suite for comparison; additional tuning uses separately labeled development scenarios; do not describe repeatedly tuned evaluation as blind final test
claim_boundary: No training or new physics rollout executed by data preparation; no recovery success claim
